notes: Partition verified: all 16 source and 17 target IDs are used exactly once across the 16 units.

The fronted *Dost* stays with the participle because no interrogative morpheme stands in the Hebrew; rule 17 reserves the fronted auxiliary for a present הֲ or אִם, as at JOB.2.3, and its last limit makes the auxiliary the verb's own here. The same reading governs *did* at JOB.2.10.
The suffix on עֹדְךָ is the participial clause's subject and takes *thou* (rules 18, 40), with עוֹד keeping *still*; identical to the עֹדֶנּוּ unit at JOB.2.3.
בְּ is unrepresented, the ASV promoting the object to a bare direct object (*hold fast thine integrity*), as at JOB.2.3.
